use_cases.name: Nominate, approve and pay a recognition award
use_cases.goal: Nominate an employee under a recognition programme, approve the award, pay any monetary part through payroll and announce it.

stakeholders.interest: Recognition is visible and any cash award is paid correctly.
Monetary awards arrive as payroll inputs, never side payments.
Star employee selection flows into the announcement without retyping.

use_cases.trigger: A recognition programme cycle opens, such as star employee of the month.
preconditions: Recognition programme with period, criteria and optional award amount is configured.
Approval chain for recognition is configured.
postconditions_success: Award is approved with citation and period.
Monetary part is a payroll input in a named run.
Announcement referencing the award is published.
postconditions_failure: Rejected nomination creates no payroll input and no announcement.

main_flow.action: Nominates an employee against a recognition programme with citation, period and award amount on the recognition screen.
Approves the award in the approvals inbox.
Raises the monetary component as a recognition award payroll input in a named run.
Publishes an announcement that references the award to the programme's audience.

alternate_flows.condition: HR applies an editorial override before publish.
steps: HR edits the announcement text or withholds publication with a reason.

exception_flows.condition: Someone attempts to record the cash award as a payment outside payroll.
exception_flows.handling: No such path exists; the award is payable only via a payroll input.
Nominator is informed with the comment; no input or announcement is produced.

nfrs: Announcement published within 5 minutes of approval.
Award certificate shows period and criteria.

user_stories.want: to nominate a star employee with a citation

acceptance.given: the star employee programme for June with a 5,000 award
acceptance.when: I nominate E1018 with a citation
acceptance.then: the nomination is created with period June

user_stories.want: recognition cash awards as payroll inputs
user_stories.so_that: they are taxed and paid properly

acceptance.given: an approved award of 5,000 for E1018
acceptance.then: a recognition award input of 5,000 appears

acceptance.given: an approved award with no cash

user_stories.want: my award announced to colleagues automatically

acceptance.then: an announcement referencing my award appears to the programme audience

acceptance.given: HR withholds the announcement with a reason
acceptance.then: no announcement is published and the reason is recorded

use_cases.name: Generate and publish announcements
use_cases.goal: Generate announcements from lifecycle and recognition events or manual input, apply audience rules and channels, and allow editorial override before publish.

stakeholders.interest: Receives relevant announcements in their language and channel.

use_cases.trigger: A lifecycle event (birthday, new joiner, award, referral) occurs or HR creates a manual message.
preconditions: Announcement types with audience rules and channels are configured.
postconditions_success: Announcement is published to the resolved audience on chosen channels.
postconditions_failure: Withheld announcements are recorded with reason.

main_flow.action: Detects a qualifying event such as a birthday today or a joiner dated today.
Drafts the announcement from the type's template, referencing the source event.
Resolves the audience rule, for example same site or same department.
Reviews the draft and may edit or withhold it before the publish time.
Publishes to in-app feed, mobile and business messaging channel per configuration.
Reads the announcement within their audience.

alternate_flows.condition: HR creates a manual management message.
steps: HR writes the message and selects audience and channels.

exception_flows.condition: Employee has opted out of birthday announcements.
exception_flows.handling: No birthday announcement is generated for that employee.
Failure is logged and retried; in-app delivery is unaffected.

nfrs: Announcements visible only within the resolved audience.

user_stories.want: birthday and new joiner announcements raised automatically
user_stories.so_that: no one has to type them daily

acceptance.given: E1018's birthday is today and a joiner is dated today
acceptance.then: both announcements are drafted for the configured audience

acceptance.given: I withhold one with a reason
acceptance.then: it is not published and the reason is recorded

user_stories.want: to see only announcements meant for my site

acceptance.given: an announcement targeted to the Pune site

use_cases.name: Generate, approve and issue HR letters
use_cases.goal: Produce HR letters from versioned templates, ensure human review, approve where required and issue with the template version retained.

stakeholders.interest: Any reprint reproduces exactly what was issued.
Letters are produced quickly without retyping.

use_cases.trigger: A lifecycle event needs a letter, such as appointment, confirmation or revision.
postconditions_success: Issued letter is stored with template version, issuer and file reference.

main_flow.action: Selects a letter template; merge fields populate from the employee record.
Renders the draft, marking whether the system or an agent drafted it, for human review.
Approves the draft where the template requires approval.
Issues the letter and retains it against the person with the template version that produced it.

steps: Draft proceeds to issue after HR review.

alternate_flows.condition: HR reprints a previously issued letter.
steps: Platform reproduces the letter from the retained version.

exception_flows.condition: Template references a non-existent merge field.
exception_flows.handling: Template fails validation on save, not at issue.

exception_flows.condition: Attempt to issue an agent-drafted letter without human review.
exception_flows.handling: Issue is refused until a human reviews it.

nfrs: Reprint reproduces byte-identical content to the original issue.

user_stories.want: letters drafted from templates with merge fields filled
user_stories.so_that: I issue letters quickly and accurately

acceptance.given: an appointment template and employee E1066
acceptance.then: the draft shows E1066's name, designation and joining date

acceptance.given: a template referencing a missing field

user_stories.want: reprints to reproduce the original version

acceptance.given: an appointment letter issued to E1066 from an earlier template version
acceptance.when: I reprint two years later after the template changed

acceptance.then: template version, issuer and date are shown

use_cases.name: Run pulse and engagement surveys
use_cases.goal: Run pulse and engagement surveys including eNPS with anonymity thresholds, multilingual delivery and action planning.
postconditions_success: Results are available above the threshold and action plans are tracked.
postconditions_failure: Results below the threshold are suppressed.

main_flow.action: Builds a survey with questions including eNPS.
Selects audience, languages and schedule.
Delivers the survey in each employee's preferred language.
Responds anonymously.
Aggregates results and suppresses groups below the anonymity threshold.
Reviews team results and creates an action plan.
Tracks action plan progress.

steps: Survey link is sent through the business messaging channel.

exception_flows.condition: Team has fewer respondents than the threshold.
exception_flows.handling: Results are rolled up to the next level.

nfrs: Responses are not linkable to respondents by any role.

user_stories.want: to answer surveys knowing I cannot be identified

acceptance.then: my manager sees results only at the next level

user_stories.want: team eNPS and an action plan

acceptance.then: eNPS and question scores are shown

use_cases.name: Manage wellbeing programmes with consent
use_cases.goal: Manage wellbeing programmes, EAP access and opt-in challenges without storing health data beyond explicit consent.

stakeholders.interest: Programme participation is measurable in aggregate.

use_cases.trigger: HR launches a programme or an employee seeks support.
preconditions: Programmes and consent text are configured.

main_flow.action: Publishes a wellbeing programme or challenge.
Browses programmes and EAP contact options.
Opts in to a challenge and gives explicit consent for the data collected.
Records only the consented data.
Views aggregate participation only.
Withdraws consent at any time; data is deleted.

steps: Contact details are shown; no access record is stored.

nfrs: No individual wellbeing signal is visible to managers.

user_stories.want: to withdraw consent and have my data deleted

use_cases.name: Moderate communities and the social feed
use_cases.goal: Provide moderated communities and a social feed for announcements, recognition and interest groups.
use_cases.trigger: Employee posts or joins a community.
postconditions_success: Approved posts are visible to the community.
postconditions_failure: Removed posts are hidden with reason recorded.

main_flow.action: Joins an interest community.
Posts content.
Screens content against moderation policy.
Publishes the post to community members.
Reports an inappropriate post.
Reviews reports and removes or keeps the post with reason.

steps: Post is held for moderator review.

exception_flows.handling: Post is removed and the author notified with reason.

user_stories.want: to remove posts violating policy with reason

acceptance.then: it is hidden and the author is notified
